newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday as Banque Audi shares held steady at $17.25 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $12.5 from $12.625.
Solidere A shares held steady at Wednesday's $10.5 and B shares were also unchanged at $10.875.
Turnover in Audi shares rose sharply to 53,730 shares from 15,150 on Wednesday and 4,000 Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares were traded against 15,706 a day earlier.
The Audi activity included a bloc trade of 38,099 shares that changed hands outside the floor at $17.25.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 67,828 shares for a value of $826,496 compared with Wednesday's 87,992 shares for a value of $1,060,855.
The BLOM index fell 0.01 percent to 908.54 and the LISPI stock index fell also 0.10 percent to 81.58.
